description:
User explicitly approved RAM-only Mnesia on 2026-10-13 after discussion of restart message-decryption risk. No disk state, checkpoints or replication. Preserve existing unrelated BO worktree edits. No Git mutations authorized.
Policies: docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md, docs/services/channels.md, docs/services/system-config.md, docs/services/engine.md; docs/documentation.md before docs edits.
Architecture: Channels owns profile-scoped Mnesia ram_copies table; only session and sender_key namespaces are volatile. Pairing creds and other protocol records remain encrypted through Engine. Keep per-call confidential Engine binding validation for RAM access. User approves loss on node/Mnesia restart; listener restart retains RAM state. No new UI; no new E2E required.
Own lib/zaq/channels/linked_device/session_storage.ex, Channels supervisor, mix.exs and Mnesia config. Mnesia local_content ram_copies only, schema_location ram; bootstrap before bridge loader. Scoped by connector/credential/profile, synchronous transactions, bounded values/profile capacity, idempotent seed once and complete scoped cleanup. No disk fallback or schema creation. Tests first: actual ram table configuration; round trips and namespace/profile isolation property; concurrent writes; failed write atomicity and capacity; listener-process independence; missing table fail closed. Reset testing in separate BEAM process to avoid shared VM corruption. Action reuse: local-only protocol infrastructure behind existing storage callbacks, not agent/workflow operation; existing TemporaryStorage remains provisional pairing owner.

comments.text: Implemented node-local Mnesia ram_copies with RAM schema, scoped transactions and bounded records, idempotent seed and cleanup. mix q passed; RAM store tests: 5 tests and 1 property passed, including isolated BEAM restart/no-disk test. No commits authorized.
